audit.summary: Four Major findings: signed fairness interpretation, inconsistent main experimental summaries/released analysis, resampled controlled inputs, and mismatched member scores in face HPP; one Minor invalid Bayesian likelihood identity.
limitations: Limitations: Current source does not establish historical experimental provenance.
Limitations: No author code executed or imported; no datasets/checkpoints/raw predictions reproduced.
Limitations: Complete static reading limited to named core files/notebooks; other ancillary implementations not audited.
Limitations: All source figures viewed qualitatively, not digitized.
Limitations: Patient overlap and interpolation-sweep implementation not established.

P1 — Counterevidence: The exact per-run absolute means and p-values are unavailable; because P2 also finds aggregation mismatches, the signed numbers are a compatible diagnostic, not a recovered raw run. Positive-gap cases and AOD can still support some disparate benefits.

P2 — Counterevidence: The complement error would produce large values unlike published small deltas, so it cannot be asserted as their actual origin. Different scripts/checkpoints/aggregation can explain the inconsistency but are not identified. Performance gains remain positive in the tabulated example.

P3 — Counterevidence: Historical code could use fixed inputs and the actual numerical bias cannot be recovered. A model invariant to the changing image would not show this artifact; the issue is failure to isolate model variation, not inevitable positive bias in every metric.

P4 — Counterevidence: The example proves possible artificial degradation, not empirical direction or size; if members share suitable scales/predictions the effect can vanish. Historical source may differ, and medical HPP was not audited for this index error.

P5 — Counterevidence: Eq8 remains exactly the mean member NLL minus ensemble NLL at common inputs. The empirical diversity diagnostic and experiments do not invoke Eq15 as a theorem certifying their causal effect. The exact equality can hold for constant joint likelihood but that assumption is absent.
The original report's complete scope, counterevidence and unresolved questions are retained below.
This import checks publication format and identity; it does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific review is pending; author adoption has not been requested.

proposition.claim:
Signed SPD/EOD decreases can be wrongly interpreted as less disparity.

Main summaries disagree and released analysis mixes datasets, sizes and complements.

Controlled evaluation changes the second input image between ensemble members for only one group.

Member-specific thresholds evaluated on member zero scores.

Log marginal likelihood ratio is not the Jensen diversity gap.
